newsitem.title: SPAIN: Car bomb explodes in Spain's Basque country.
newsitem.headline: Car bomb explodes in Spain's Basque country.

text.p: A car bomb exploded in Spain's Basque country late on Sunday but noone was hurt in the blast, local authorities said.
The bomb went off shortly before midnight outside offices of a wine producing firm "Bodegas y Bebidas" in San Sebastian, Spanish news agencies reported.
The reports said a security guard in the area was warned in advance about the explosion by two people who had left the car.
The facade of the wine firm was badly damaged by the blast which also shattered windows of nearby businesses.
It was the second incident of political violence this week in Spain's Basque country where the separatist group ETA is fighting for independence.
On Thursday, an unidentified gunman shot dead a bicycle merchant in San Sebastian and the government blamed ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom).
ETA has killed about 800 people in a drive for independence that began in 1968.
